lines.en: I decide to close out the night with a trip to the bar.
lines.zh: 我决定去酒吧走一趟，为这一夜收个尾。

lines.en: I’ve yet to have a drink since the whole reincarnation thing, and I’m sure Ami won’t mind if I stay out a little late every once in a while.
lines.zh: 自从那档子转生的事之后，我还一滴酒都没沾过；而且我确信，偶尔在外面待晚一点，Ami 是不会介意的。

lines.en: Look at me, thinking some teenage girl has some amount of influence over my behavior.
lines.zh: 瞧我，居然以为一个十几岁的女孩能对我的行为有什么影响力。
我一定是变软了。

lines.en: The bar looks decently upscale for the area it’s in, but there aren’t any customers apart from a few old women smoking cigarettes in the corner.
lines.zh: 就它所在的地段而言，这家酒吧看着还挺上档次的，但除了角落里几个抽着烟的老太太，一个客人都没有。

lines.en: I walk past them and take a seat at the bar, not noticing until now that the bartender looks exceedingly familiar...
lines.zh: 我从她们身边走过，在吧台前坐下，直到这时才注意到——那位调酒师看起来眼熟得过分……
: ……Sana？
: 您好……

lines.en: : I had no idea you worked at a bar.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你在酒吧打工。
: 我……知道这违反校规……

lines.en: : Am I...going to get in trouble?...
lines.zh: : 我会……惹上麻烦吗？……

lines.en: : With me? No. I’m not here to tell you how to live your life.
lines.zh: : 跟我？不会。我来这儿不是为了教你该怎么过日子。

lines.en: : Just try and keep it a secret from anyone more important than me and I'm sure you'll be fine.
lines.zh: : 只要对那些比我更重要的人保密就行，我保证你不会有事。
: 您……是真心的吗？……
: 因为……您走进来的时候，我——

lines.en: : I mean it. I {i}am{/i} a little surprised you work somewhere like this, though.
lines.zh: : 我是真心的。不过我{i}确实{/i}有点意外，你会在这种地方打工。
: 为什么？

lines.en: : You just...don’t really seem like the bartender type, I guess?
lines.zh: : 只是……你看起来不太像是当调酒师的那一型吧？
: 「当调酒师的那一型」……是什么样的？……

lines.en: : Probably someone old enough to legally drink. But I'm sure you hear enough of that from your customers.
lines.zh: : 大概是到了法定饮酒年龄的人吧。不过这种话你肯定已经从客人那儿听够了。
: 嗯……其实并没有……

lines.en: : Most of the people who come here have been coming here for years...so I've known them for a really long time...
lines.zh: : 来这儿的人大多都来了好多年了……所以我认识他们已经很久很久了……

lines.en: : How long have you been working here, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那你到底在这儿工作多久了？

lines.en: : I haven't been...{i}working{/i} here for long...but my mom lives upstairs, so...I...kind of grew up here...or something.
lines.zh: : 我在这儿{i}工作{/i}的时间还不长……不过我妈妈住在楼上，所以……我……算是这儿长大的……大概吧。

lines.en: : You live above a bar? That's amazing.
lines.zh: : 你住在酒吧楼上？太棒了。

lines.en: : Well...{i}I{/i} live in the dorms now, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……不过{i}我{/i}现在住在宿舍里，所以……

lines.en: : Shame. Though, I guess that probably helps with you not becoming an alcoholic at an early age. Not that I imagine you drink much to begin with.
lines.zh: : 可惜了。不过话说回来，这大概也让你不至于小小年纪就成了酒鬼。虽然我本来也不觉得你能喝多少。

lines.en: Sana doesn’t seem much different than she does in class. She’s still just as quiet as ever.
lines.zh: Sana 看起来和她在课堂上没什么两样。还是一如既往地安静。

lines.en: Well- scratch that. She {i}does{/i} seem different. But only in the fact that she is significantly more adorable in her work clothes than she is in her school uniform.
lines.zh: 啊不，当我没说。她{i}确实{/i}看起来不一样。只不过是因为她穿着工作服，比穿校服时可爱多了。

lines.en: Which is a weird thing to admit since my attraction to school girls has been slapping me across the face ever since {i}waking up.{/i}
lines.zh: 承认这一点挺奇怪的，毕竟自从{i}醒来{/i}之后，我对女高中生的那点心思就一直在扇我耳光。

lines.en: Either way, I am now obligated to test the waters and compliment her appearance because that is just the type of guy I am.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我现在有义务试探一下、夸一夸她的打扮，因为我就是这种人。

lines.en: : Those clothes fit you well, Sana.
lines.zh: : 这身衣服很适合你，Sana。
: Sana？
: 哦……抱歉……谢谢您……
: 只是……那是我哥哥的衣服。

lines.en: : Were? Does he not work here anymore?
lines.zh: : 曾经是？他现在不在这儿工作了吗？

lines.en: : That's not...really something I want to talk about right now...if that's okay...
lines.zh: : 这个……我现在不太想谈……可以吗……

lines.en: : That's fine. I'm not going to push you out of your comfort zone until the second or third time we hang out after class...
lines.zh: : 没关系。等我们课后出去玩到第二、第三次的时候，我才会把你推出舒适区……

lines.en: : I...don't think that's...a thing we should do...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得那样的事……我们不该做……

lines.en: : That aside, do you think you could pour me a drink? That's kind of the whole reason I'm here, after all.
lines.zh: : 先不说这个，你能给我倒杯酒吗？毕竟我来这儿就是为了这个。
: 您喝酒吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : What other reason would I have to come to a bar?
lines.zh: : 不然我还有什么理由来酒吧？
: 哦……也是……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Well, what can I get for you then?...
lines.zh: : 那么，您要喝点什么？……

lines.en: : Just a beer, thanks. I'm not really a liquor person.
lines.zh: : 就来杯啤酒吧，谢谢。我不太喝烈酒。
: 好的……马上就好。

lines.en: Sana moves to the opposite end of the bar and opens up a cooler that must be at least twenty years old.
lines.zh: Sana 走到吧台另一头，打开了一台少说也有二十年历史的冷藏柜。

lines.en: She pushes aside a few half-empty syrup bottles and grabs me a can of some beer I don't recognize.
lines.zh: 她拨开几只半空的糖浆瓶，给我拿了一罐我不认识的啤酒。
: 这到底是什么？

lines.en: : You...{i}did{/i} say you wanted a beer...right?...
lines.zh: : 您……{i}是{/i}说要啤酒……对吧？……

lines.en: : Yeah, I just don't recognize this kind.
lines.zh: : 对，我只是没见过这个牌子。

lines.en: : We...only carry alcohol from the local brewery, so...I'm sorry if it's not to your liking...
lines.zh: : 我们……只卖本地酿酒厂的酒，所以……要是不合您口味，我很抱歉……
: Kumon-mi 还有酿酒厂？

lines.en: : If there wasn't...we'd have a problem...
lines.zh: : 要是没有……那可就麻烦了……

lines.en: : Well hey, beer is beer and I got what I asked for.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，啤酒就是啤酒，我要的就是这个。

lines.en: Sana pulls the tab of the can open and slides it over to me as if she's doing it from muscle memory but, well, I guess that's to be expected given the environment she's apparently grown up in.
lines.zh: Sana 拉开易拉罐的拉环，把它推到我面前，动作熟练得像是出于肌肉记忆——不过话说回来，考虑到她显然是在这种环境里长大的，倒也理所应当。

lines.en: Assuming she's not done {i}growing up,{/i} that is.
lines.zh: 当然，前提是她还没{i}长大成人{/i}。

lines.en: It’s still strange seeing someone so [young]doing a job like this, though.
lines.zh: 不过，看到这么[young]的人做这样的工作，还是挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : So how long has your family been running this place, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那你们家经营这地方，到底多久了？
: 从……我出生以前很久就开始了……

lines.en: : My grandma and grandpa opened the bar a long time ago...
lines.zh: : 我爷爷奶奶很久以前开了这家酒吧……

lines.en: : My...mom told me it used to be really popular when she was a little girl...
lines.zh: : 我……妈妈跟我说，她小时候这儿可火了……
: 可……现在，却……

lines.en: Sana's eyes navigate to the corner of the room, where the group of old women sit.
lines.zh: Sana 的目光移向房间角落——那群老太太就坐在那儿。

lines.en: Now that she's redirected her attention over there, I become acutely aware that they've been mysteriously quiet ever since I showed up.
lines.zh: 她把注意力转向那边，我也猛然意识到——自我出现以来，她们就一直安静得诡异。

lines.en: They're old, though. They probably just ran out of energy or something. That seems like an old-person thing to do.
lines.zh: 不过她们上了年纪。大概只是没力气了之类的。这种事听起来确实像老年人会干的。

lines.en: : So I guess this place is pretty much the shell of its former self then?
lines.zh: : 那么，这地方现在大概只剩下过去的一副空壳了吧？

lines.en: : That's a...good way to describe it...
lines.zh: : 这……是个很贴切的说法……

lines.en: : You don't...think it's because of me...do you?...
lines.zh: : 您……不觉得是因为我吧？……

lines.en: : I mean, I’ve only been here once, so I can’t say for sure...but I highly doubt that’s it.
lines.zh: : 我是说，我才来过一次，所以不好说……不过我非常怀疑是这个原因。

lines.en: : If anything, I’d think having a bartender as cute as you would reel even more customers in.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我反倒觉得有个像你这么可爱的调酒师，能招来更多客人。

lines.en: : You could probably work on your social skills a bit, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，你的社交能力大概还得再练练。

lines.en: : What I mean is that {i}I{/i} know you’re naturally this quiet, but newer customers might not get that right away.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，{i}我{/i}知道你天生就这么安静，可新客人未必马上就能明白。

lines.en: : I was...kind of worried that might be the case...
lines.zh: : 我……有点担心会是那样……

lines.en: : Sensei...do you know any tricks to...you know...
lines.zh: : Sensei……您知道有什么诀窍吗……就是……

lines.en: : Get better at having conversations with strangers?
lines.zh: : 让自己更擅长和陌生人聊天？
: 嗯……算不上。
: 这样啊……

lines.en: : It’s just something you sort of have to do if you ever want to make it through life.
lines.zh: : 这不过是你想在人生里走下去，就多少得做的事。

lines.en: : Look at me- I don’t like talking to strangers 99%% of the time, but I still do it because that’s just how life works.
lines.zh: : 看看我——我有百分之九十九的时候都不喜欢跟陌生人说话，可我还是会说，因为生活就是这么运转的。

lines.en: : You can’t just avoid everything forever. If life were that simple, we wouldn’t need jobs or[school] or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 你不可能永远躲开一切。要是生活真那么简单，我们就不需要工作、不需要[school]，也不需要那些乱七八糟的东西了。
: 我……想您说得对。

lines.en: : You seem to be talking to me just fine, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你跟我聊得不是挺好的吗。

lines.en: : Well...I’ve talked to you before, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我之前跟您说过话，所以……

lines.en: : Maybe we just need to talk a little more, then?
lines.zh: : 那也许我们只是需要多聊一点？
: 多……聊一点？……

lines.en: : By opening up more to me, you might get better at opening up to others. Right?
lines.zh: : 你对我敞开心扉多一点，说不定也会更擅长对别人敞开心扉。对吧？

lines.en: : Um...I don’t really know about that...
lines.zh: : 嗯……这个我不太清楚……
: 那就这么定了。
: 等等，定什么？……我……突然糊涂了……

lines.en: : I’m going to help teach you some social skills whenever I drop by the bar.
lines.zh: : 我以后每次来这酒吧，都会帮你练练社交能力。

lines.en: It's not like I plan on teaching her anything in school, so this is just my way to make up for that.
lines.zh: 反正我在学校里也没打算教她什么，这就算是我弥补的方式吧。

lines.en: : Sensei, I...don’t really have time for extra classes...
lines.zh: : Sensei，我……真的没有时间上额外的课……

lines.en: : Is it really an extra class if you're on the clock for it?
lines.zh: : 要是你是在上班时间上的，那还算额外的课吗？

lines.en: : Is that...really okay, though?...Isn’t this place...a little far from your home?...
lines.zh: : 可是……这样真的好吗？……这地方……离您家是不是有点远？……

lines.en: : It’s not that bad. Plus, if it’s for you, I don’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 没那么远。再说，如果是为了你，我一点都不介意。

lines.en: : You really mean that?...You’ll go out of your way for me?...
lines.zh: : 您是真的吗？……您愿意为我特意跑一趟？……

lines.en: : Of course. You’re one of my students. Plus, it will give you an incentive to reward me with free drinks and that is always a plus.
lines.zh: : 当然。你是我的学生之一。再说，这也能给你一个动力，用免费酒水来报答我，而这永远是个加分项。

lines.en: : Heheh...well...we'll...have to see about that part...
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……嗯……那部分……还得再看吧……

lines.en: : Because...I don't really think we're in the position right now to...be able to do that...
lines.zh: : 因为……我觉得我们现在的情况……还做不到那一步……

lines.en: : Well, lucky for you, I'm paying tonight.
lines.zh: : 那你运气不错，今晚我来付钱。

lines.en: I chug the remainder of my beer and slide the can back to Sana.
lines.zh: 我把剩下的啤酒一口气灌完，把空罐推回给 Sana。

lines.en: : That's...not exactly {i}lucky{/i} for me...That's just...kind of how...buying things works...
lines.zh: : 那……对我来说算不上{i}运气好{/i}……那只是……买东西本来……就是这样嘛……

lines.en: : Then you're lucky I decided to stop by here instead of some other bar.
lines.zh: : 那你该庆幸我选的是这儿，而不是别的酒吧。
: 嘿嘿……这我……倒没法反驳……
: 您还要再来一杯吗？

lines.en: : I’m fine for tonight, actually. I think I’m going to head out.
lines.zh: : 今晚我就够了。我想我该走了。
: 哦……哦……这样啊……

lines.en: : I’ll be back soon, though. Just keep trying to improve on your own in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 不过我很快就会再来。这段时间你自己也继续努力。

lines.en: : I’ll try but...I’m pretty bad...I can't really promise that...there will be any progress...
lines.zh: : 我会试试，不过……我挺不行的……我不太敢保证……会有进步……

lines.en: : Well, I'm passable. So I'm sure everything will all work out in the long run.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我还算凑合。所以我相信长远来看一切都会好起来。
: 好的……我相信您……
: 晚安，Sensei……我们很快会再见。
: 我相信会的。
: 晚安，Sana。

lines.en: I take a handful of coins out of my pocket and leave them on the counter without ever asking for a bill.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里抓出一把硬币放在柜台上，压根没要账单。

lines.en: I'm sure it's a lot more than necessary, but it's not like I have anything I'm saving up for. And spending that money on Sana might be a good tool to get her to open up to me.
lines.zh: 我知道这肯定远超应付的数目，可我又没什么要攒钱买的东西。而且把钱花在 Sana 身上，说不定是让她对我敞开心扉的好办法。

lines.en: Is that technically a form of bribery? Sure. I guess you could say that.
lines.zh: 严格来说这算不算一种贿赂？算吧。你大可以这么说。

lines.en: But if there's anyone bribery works on, it's a family in financial turmoil.
lines.zh: 不过要说贿赂对谁最管用，那就是陷入财务困境的家庭。

lines.en: I start my journey home with slightly lighter pockets, but a slightly more optimistic outlook for the future.
lines.zh: 我踏上了回家的路，口袋稍微轻了些，对未来的期待却稍微亮了些。

lines.en: And that's a fair trade to me.
lines.zh: 对我来说，这是一笔公平的交易。
{i}Sana 的好感度提升到了 [sana_love]！{/i}
